speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I am going round by the baker's first. Meet me by the new frames, and keep out of the lime.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will keep to the dry side. Thy grandfather's word has bought thee a morning, Hamnet. The sword may cross the lane, and it comes home.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mensa, mensae, mensam. Look, Judith, I can say the whole table walking backward to the corner.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: Say the plural, then, or it counts for nothing.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: Mind the kennel. The shearman's board by the corner is new painted since last year, and the glover next him has hung a white hart where the bush was.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two new signs. Heels behind thee, boy, before thy back finds the trough.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: Mensarum, mensis, mensas. And not a splash.
